content: Luconia was first named "Curation Client" by Cxdrion (who is actually Lumo using a different name). Then, Cxdrion created a new Discord account (the Lumo account), gave the ownership of the Curation Discord server to his new account, and rebranded it to Luconia, giving it a fresh start. Luconia Client was one of the most popular clients ever made. It was the first one to release a working mod menu for PCs and mobile devices. A lot of people were upset about it because the client community was at its best. Some of the problems include stolen code and the Discord moderator "Blue Boy". People were really looking forward to Luconia v2, but it never came out. The person who made it, Lumo, stopped working on it and started a new channel on YouTube called "Flxshed." The new owner, Nyami, never really managed to create version 2, but they did create a beta DLL for Luconia. They promised a better version, which of course never happened or is still in the works.

content: The Cleanest Experience Of MCBE You'll Ever Have! ©Project Light Productions • 2024

# Glacier Client

A premium, free JSON UI texture pack for Minecraft Bedrock Edition (1.21+) that enhances visuals and performance with a fully customizable HUD and optimized utility modules. Runs smoothly on **Windows**, **Android**, and **iOS**.

## ✨ Features

* **Mod Menu** — a tabbed interface (Modules, Elements, Editor, Music Player) to toggle, configure, and freely drag, scale, and reposition every module on screen.
* **HUD Modules** — Armor HUD, Status HUD, Direction HUD, Target HUD, Main/Off-hand HUD, Bow Indicator, Speedometer, FPS counter, coordinates, day-event timer, walk distance, and more.
* **Item Counters** — live tracking for Totems, Splash Potions, Arrows, and per-slot counts, plus low-durability and shiny-potion alerts.
* **Navigation & Tracking** — chunk map, ore visualizer, custom timers, EXP calculator, player list, server display, and automatic death coordinates.
* **Custom Containers** — redesigned chest, brewing stand, furnace, anvil, enchanting, and smithing table screens with a tooltip display panel and brewing guide.
* **Visual Styling** — customizable crosshairs, hotbar themes, styled XP bars, brightness overlay, and an animated start screen with changelog.


*Made by @PepeYT· Glacier Productions © 2026*

content:
After Luconia, the main developer, Velan, focused on his YouTube channel. After some time, he returned to pack development and created Azelux under his new name, Velan. The Azelux Client is the spiritual successor of the Luconia Client. It is the first client to offer an easy way to save your configuration and cosmetics. While V1 was designed to resemble the Lunar Client, Azelux was originally intended to resemble the Feather Client, as can be seen in the alpha versions. To "perfect" this client, Velan enlisted the help of other developers. lliT is a lead developer and owner, and Pepe helped with several modules. The Azelux codebase is just a mix of the Glacier and Cobalt clients, with some additions. After much anticipation for V1, the release was rather disappointing, as the game crashed on low-end devices. No fix has ever been released for this issue, with Velan saying, "Just wait for v2." As the spiritual successor of Luconia, V2 was never released, with most of the developers quitting after V1. This left only Velan on the team, who is rarely active nowadays, dooming another anticipated release to never see the light of day.

 In the screenshots, you can see some concepts.
